title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: Athens is very walkable, and in fact, you will be covering a lot of the old city on foot.

From Athens to Santorini, we regretfully flew Volotea as it was the cheapest airline. We were charged a stupid amount in extra fees for not checking in in advance because their own website was down! But the alternatives don’t appear to be much better.
If you have time to spare, you could take a ferry which takes 5-8 hours as opposed to 1 hour by flight.
